text: Before entry, the environment shall establish processor/runtime/stacks, final global locations/relocations, constant values, serial dynamic initialization, and gated application entry. Entry shall be designated, fixed-arity, non-raising, and supported by its ABI; normal results shall have a defined logical i32 status mapping.
